inputs.text: Candid smartphone photo of a 24-year-old Costa Rican woman, mestiza, warm light-brown skin with visible pores, a few small acne marks and light freckles on her cheeks, slight dark circles under her eyes, thick dark wavy hair slightly frizzy from humidity, tied in a loose messy bun with loose strands. Natural face, no makeup, slightly uneven eyebrows, genuine half-smile. Wearing a plain faded t-shirt. Sitting at a small roadside soda in Guápiles, Costa Rica, plastic table, tropical vegetation and a light rain in the background. Overcast natural daylight, slightly underexposed, mild motion blur, shot on iPhone, unedited, no filter, realistic skin texture, everyday amateur photo.
